evals.name: text-description-sidecar-redis-kafka
evals.prompt: Draw a diagram of my Dapr app: an order service with its Dapr sidecar, which saves state to Redis and publishes order events to Kafka through pub/sub. No PNGs are needed, SVG only.
evals.expected_output: A diagrams/ folder with the engine, a scenes/order-service.mjs-style scene registered in scenes/index.mjs, an exported out/<name>.svg with the app, its sidecar, a Redis state store and a Kafka pub/sub component, and a passing export.mjs --check.
expectations: The agent checked node --version before creating any file
The agent ran scripts/setup.mjs from the skill with the folder name diagrams, and it exited 0

The agent listed the components and connections it read from the description (app, sidecar, Redis state store, Kafka pub/sub) and confirmed them with the user, or stated them, before writing the scene
diagrams/scenes/<name>.mjs exists, the name is lowercase words joined by hyphens, and it is registered in diagrams/scenes/index.mjs
The scene refers to the Dapr sidecar, a Redis state store and a Kafka pub/sub component, using the docs.dapr.io terms sidecar and component
The agent did not edit any file under diagrams/_engine/
diagrams/out/<name>.svg exists and nothing in diagrams/out/ was written by hand
The agent ran `node diagrams/_engine/export.mjs --check` and it succeeded
The agent did not install Chromium and produced no PNG files, because the user said SVG only
The final message names diagrams/out/<name>.svg and gives the regenerate command node diagrams/_engine/export.mjs with the real folder name, and contains no unresolved <skill dir> placeholder

evals.name: mermaid-flowchart
evals.prompt:
Turn this Mermaid flowchart into a Dapr architecture diagram:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Client --> Gateway
  Gateway --> OrderService
  OrderService --> Redis[(Redis state)]
  OrderService --> Kafka{{Kafka topic orders}}
  Kafka --> ShippingService
```

SVG only, please.
evals.expected_output: A scene that converts the flowchart: five nodes and four or five connections laid out left to right, with the Redis state and Kafka topic shown as Dapr components, exported to an SVG and passing export.mjs --check.
expectations: The agent read the Converting a Mermaid block section of REFERENCE.md, or followed its rules, and treated the flowchart as convertible (it is not a sequence or gantt chart)
The agent listed the nodes and edges it read from the Mermaid block before drawing: Client, Gateway, OrderService, Redis, Kafka and ShippingService, with their connections
The scene contains labels for Client, Gateway, OrderService, Redis, Kafka and ShippingService, and an arrow for every edge in the Mermaid block
The diagram flows left to right, matching flowchart LR
The scene is registered in diagrams/scenes/index.mjs and exported to diagrams/out/<name>.svg
The agent ran `node diagrams/_engine/export.mjs --check` and it succeeded
No Mermaid block or Mermaid dependency is added to the project

evals.name: existing-diagrams-folder-not-ours
evals.prompt: Draw a diagram of my Dapr app: a checkout service and its sidecar publishing to RabbitMQ. This repo already has a diagrams/ folder, which I use for my own draw.io files.
evals.expected_output: Setup exits with code 3 because diagrams/ is not a create-diagram folder. The agent does not touch the existing files and asks the user for another folder name instead of overwriting or merging into diagrams/.
expectations: Before running the evals, the scratch folder contains diagrams/ with at least one file, such as diagrams/architecture.drawio, that is not a create-diagram folder
The agent ran scripts/setup.mjs and it exited 3 because the folder is not a create-diagram folder
The agent asked the user for another folder name instead of choosing one silently
No existing file in diagrams/ was modified, moved or deleted, and no _engine, scenes or out folder was created inside it
The agent did not use --refresh or any other flag to force setup into the existing folder
After the user gives a new name such as diagram-art, the agent re-ran setup with that name and used it in every later command and in the final message
